limits: Inclusive category times overlap; never add inclusive parent and child totals. Exclusive row residual includes cache lookup, object/array operations, stretch bookkeeping, validation and wrapper/JIT overhead; it is not an isolated allocation time.

Timing uses whole-function and one coarse RGB block boundaries, not per scalar operation. Per-call performance.now/stack bookkeeping and wrappers perturb optimization and GC; count-only/original controls expose perturbation, not a reliable time correction.
Signed control differences may be negative due to schedule/JIT/noise; they are retained, not clamped or interpreted as negative physical work.

Imported contact helper internal motion is included in contact-support, not separately intercepted. Partial-contact RGB calls in their own module are included in partial-contact-records; do not claim the RGB-window counter captures them.

Repeated updates at the same committed phase make fresh recordsGeneration without advancing physical time. This is CPU attribution, not native evolving wall-clock performance, browser FPS or GPU shader timing.
No curve, material, shutter, projection, sample count, pixel, audio, source setting or production file is changed.
